title: Reject unsupported manual stock-out units before sales shipment commitment
description: Apply established shared unit eligibility to stock-out without changing stock-in policy. StockOut manual/unlinked drafts currently pass any nonempty unit through shared package-only conversion; live product and positive numeric validation502 does not prove a posted quantity is in the actual product base unit. Enforce only existing base/package unit semantics at draft writes before numbering and operational commitment under current sales-source/stock locks. Explicit linked source remains mandatory only where existing flow requires it; no automatic sales/source inference. Preserve valid package to base quantity exactly once and current repeated-line/cumulative shipment semantics. Preserve current identity/menu/customer scope, live product/warehouse/supplier validation, source ownership/capacity locks and atomic posting/reversal. No new grants, schema/migration, database, automatic source links or historical unit rewrite. Only explicitly supplied nonempty unsupported units are rejected; preserve established empty-unit/base-unit fallback after checking existing code/tests, or fail controlled if no base unit exists rather than inventing a new unit. Case-insensitive trimmed comparisons use current semantics. Package conversion applies exactly once using current positive UnitsPerPackage, keeps authoritative base quantity and existing rounding policy; downstream storage bounds and overflow guards remain. No conversion/inference between arbitrary units. No new historical read/cancel/unaudit gate. Adapt original unit/SQL fixtures genuinely without deleting assertions. Unique unused per-invocation logs/TRX under .ai/logs/<task>; preserve full original failures. Genuine SQL uses fresh GUID NEWERP_AUTOTEST only, no drop/reset/reuse/production. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized manual and linked draft writes reject explicitly supplied units outside the referenced live product base/package units before number reservation, tracked header/detail replacement or any persistence. Preserve existing supported blank-unit fallback and valid base/package inputs, repeated product rows and optional source semantics; invalid/missing base/package configuration yields controlled error without guessing.

Operational submit/approve revalidate effective stored unit/master/source eligibility in existing document/source locks. Package quantity is normalized exactly once and not reconverted on commitment; existing base-unit source capacity, monetary quantities, current precision/overflow guards and inventory ledger remain coherent. Rejection changes no document/status/source capacity/numbers/stock/movements; historical undo/read semantics remain.

Meaningful unit/controller and genuine isolated SQL cover unlinked and linked drafts, arbitrary nonempty unit, whitespace/case/base/package inputs, blank fallback, invalid/mutated base or package master, conversion factors/overflow, cumulative source capacity after conversion and no double conversion. Run related original fulfillment/posting/source/cancellation/concurrency SQL regressions plus safe Release/full units, preserving original failures and exact environment evidence.
implementation_evidence: StockUnitConversion common private loop:50-51 leaves unsupported nonempty unit untouched for StockOutDetail overload. StockOutAuthorizationRules numeric/master guard502 adds no unit membership proof. Sales-order fulfillment validates linked sources only; manual source-null rows still persist free unit labels. No equivalent manual stock-out unit guard in task/docs history.
